blocks.name: ANNOTATED POSE ONLY - NOT A DETECTION
blocks.description: T-LESS object 6, scene000002_frame000494_isolated. Stored supplied-pose diagnostics; this graph runs no locator. Orbit the native RGB clouds to compare sampled and all-triangle visibility. Green: supported; red: distance rejected; orange: normal rejected; blue-gray: hidden; magenta: unresolved; gray: measured scene; RGB: pose axes. Full gate values, ablations and hashes are in report.json.
